UNIVERSITI TEKNOLOGI MALAYSIA
FACULTY OF COMPUTING
SECJ3104 - APPLICATIONS DEVELOPMENT
SEMESTER I, SESSION 2026/2027

GROUP PROJECT (30%)
Campus Parking Management System

1. INTRODUCTION
Parking at UTM Johor Bahru is a daily problem for students and staff. In this project your group will
analyse the problem and build a working prototype of a parking management system. This project
contributes 30% to your final grade for this course.

2. GROUP FORMATION
Form a group of 4 to 5 members. Register your group with the lecturer by Week 2.

3. DELIVERABLES
The project consists of the following deliverables:
a) Project Proposal (10%) – due Week 4
   i. Problem statement and objectives
   ii. Project scope and Gantt chart
b) System Analysis and Design Report (25%) – due Week 9
   i. Use case diagram and use case descriptions
   ii. Class diagram and database design
c) Prototype Implementation (35%) – due Week 13
d) Final Presentation and Demo (20%) – Week 14
e) Peer Evaluation (10%)

4. SUBMISSION
- Submit all documents in PDF through UTM eLearning.
- Late submission will be penalised 10% per day, up to a maximum of 3 days.
- The similarity index (Turnitin) must be below 20%.

5. GRADING SCALE
A+   90 – 100
A    80 – 89
A-   75 – 79
B+   70 – 74
B    65 – 69
C    50 – 64
F    0 – 49

Total: 100%
